Available August 2024 · Student Property · Close to Local Shops ·

My Property Box welcome to the market a lovely maisonette in a great central location situated 50 yards from Jesmond swimming pool and close to West Jesmond metro station. The property comprises of; four double bedrooms, lounge, kitchen, bathroom, separate shower room and a study. Immaculate throughout a real home from home. Would suit professionals or students. To arrange a viewing please call My Property Box 0191 212 0400.
